top_signals.title: Red Sea Attack Sinks India-Flagged Cargo Vessel Off Yemen
top_signals.summary: An India-flagged tanker reportedly carrying Saudi oil has sunk off the coast of Yemen in the Red Sea after it was hit by a projectile. The Indian Ministry of External Affairs on Tuesday condemned the attack on the India-flagged commercial vessel, MSV Faize Noore Oliya, which sank in the Red Sea, off the coast of Yemen on August 4, 2026. Sarbananda Sonowal, India’s Minister of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, said the vessel had been hit by a projectile near Yemeni waters.   All seafarers, including 13 Indian nationals, have been rescued…

top_signals.title: On this day: the birth of press freedom
top_signals.summary: On 5th August 1735 John Peter Zenger was acquitted of seditious libel on the basis that the criticisms of the government he has printed in The New York Weekly Journal were true.
